evidenceSemantics.fixture: Portable synthetic evidence; never proof of current product behavior.
evidenceSemantics.localDevelopment: Ephemeral developer evidence tied to exact source revisions; never staging or release evidence.
evidenceSemantics.staging: Release-candidate evidence only after the exact target, tenant, personas, browser session, API credential, budget, and cleanup path are approved.
evidenceSemantics.production: Read and mutation testing are denied in this contract. Public documentation remains governed separately by the source map.

production.denialProof: Policy and host checks only; never probe production to demonstrate denial.

personas.scope: public entry and sign-in boundary only
permission-denial cases in the same test tenant
cross-tenant denial only; no access to the primary synthetic tenant
one generated application credential held only by the API connector

cleanupOrder: pause the synthetic application if deletion is not immediately safe
delete only objects carrying the exact run prefix and synthetic marker
compare the post-run inventory with the pre-run inventory
record any residue as a blocker with exact owner

green: credential-free GET of an approved loopback health endpoint
credential-free GET of the approved loopback public entry page
yellow: authenticated read inside the dedicated synthetic tenant
create or update an exactly prefixed synthetic application
create and revoke one synthetic application credential
delete an exactly prefixed synthetic object during cleanup
red: broad credential, customer, or organization access

readinessGates: exact target classification and immutable source revisions are recorded
all required health probes pass immediately before the run
a browser is connected to the exact approved control-plane host
the tenant is dedicated, synthetic, and confirmed free of customer data
admin, member, outsider, and application-client personas are independently scoped
the provider budget is approved and enforced outside application visibility-only budgeting
secrets remain inside their browser or API connector
the pre-run inventory and cleanup owner are recorded
production host denial is effective before any authenticated step
abortConditions: resolved host is not the exact approved host
environment identity or source revision changes during the run
gateway, admin, or authentication health fails
tenant contains unknown or non-synthetic data
a credential appears in output, logs, screenshots, prompts, or issue text
provider cost is unavailable or the request or spend cap is reached
a write target lacks the exact run prefix and synthetic marker
a connector exposes a new or write-capable tool outside the reviewed catalog
